 Advertisement Northern California storm impacts: Latest updates on chain controls
 Advertisement Updated: 11:15 PM PST Nov 14, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jonathan Ayestas Senior Digital Producer Northern California storm impacts: Latest updates on chain controls
 Updated: 11:15 PM PST Nov 14, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jonathan Ayestas Senior Digital Producer SACRAMENTO, Calif. — Northern California experienced the first of three forecast storm systems arriving in the region over the next several days.
 The KCRA 3 weather team issued an Impact Day for Friday because of how rain, wind and snow could affect outdoor activities and travel. 
 Advertisement When enough snow falls, road officials put chain controls into effect. When chain controls are issued, the speed limit on Interstate 80 is reduced to 30 mph. On Highway 50, it is reduced to 25 mph.
